title: Governing the AgentCore gateway: what it uses
lede: One arrow for each component this feature lists. The steps reuse the feature's own "how it works" text; nothing here is a new claim. Internal and confidential: this text comes from an internal Ping deck and has not been tested on our tenant.

steps.title: Tool targets
steps.what: Tool targets, WAF failure mode, bypass routes and endpoint pinning can be governed, and the gateway can move from log-only to enforcing.
steps.why: The release slide describes this as the gateway itself being an object of policy.
